title: A suite test pins that stem() keeps a dashed number such as S-1-5-32-544 whole
goal: A suite test asserts kbfacts.terms keeps every digit run whole, a dashed SID number included (terms('S-1-5-32-544') holds no token ending 54, terms('26100') is ['26100']), so the double-letter rule cannot regress for numbers unnoticed
